screen.scale: whole number of DEVICE px per art px (4 on a 3x phone = 387pt wide); centre the screen

player_cards.row_x: x = floor((290 - (n*84 + (n-1)*3)) / 2), then +87 for each next card (rows are always centred)
player_cards.rows: top row: up to 3 opponents. bottom row: YOU in the middle, plus up to 2 more opponents left/right (max 6 players)
player_cards.current_player: use card-<colour>-current.svg (yellow inner border) + players/turn-marker.svg centred 5px above the card

board.build: see board_background_svg.zip, city_owned_svg.zip (rent boxes) and frog_token_svg.zip (tokens)

die.roll_animation: swap faces at random every 60ms for ~600ms, then show the result

text: ALL text with pixelText.ts (font5), never a system font. Centre: x = boxX + floor((boxW - measure(text).width)/2).
label_rule: navy labels: rectangle h=11, fill #101628, corners cut by 1px, width = text width + 10, text at +5,+3
